title: DAAD RISE Germany (Research Internships in Science and Engineering)
description: A summer research internship placing undergraduate students at top German universities and research institutes, matched to a host lab in biology, chemistry, physics, computer science, earth sciences, engineering, or a closely related field, working alongside a PhD student or researcher mentor. Run by the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD). Interns receive a monthly stipend of EUR 992, an international travel subsidy, a EUR 160 travel stipend to attend the RISE meeting, and DAAD-provided health/accident/liability insurance; host institutions provide housing assistance. Open to undergraduates enrolled at a university in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, or Ireland who will have completed at least two years of their degree program by the internship start. Applicants register for a DAAD ID, browse the RISE Germany project database, and submit a separate motivation letter for each project they apply to. This entry covers the summer 2027 placement cycle: the application portal opens October 15, 2026 and closes November 30, 2026, 23:59 CET.
visaNote: This is a short-term research internship, not employment; non-EU/EEA interns should confirm Germany's short-stay/internship visa requirements well ahead of the start date.
